featured_reviews.review_text:

Very disappointed with the service experience. Would think twice before visiting again.

I recently visited Timezone at R City Mall, and it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience! The gaming zone at Timezone is vibrant, well-maintained, and packed with a wide variety of games suitable for all age groups.

From arcade classics to modern interactive games, there’s something for everyone. The machines were all in great condition, and the staff was helpful whenever needed, which made the overall experience smooth and enjoyable.

However, the highlight of our visit was definitely the bowling game! It was incredibly engaging and well-organized. What made it even more exciting was that we got 20 rounds with 10 balls per person, which gave us plenty of time to enjoy, compete, and improve our game. The setup was excellent, and the scoring system was easy to follow, making it fun even for beginners.

The atmosphere was lively, with great lighting and energetic vibes, making it a perfect place to unwind with friends or family. We genuinely had a great time laughing, competing, and just enjoying the moment.

featured_reviews.review_text: Fun City at Infinity Mall is a lively indoor amusement zone, perfect for kids and families looking to spend a fun few hours. featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun City is a two floor playing paradise for children of all age groups.
They are a number of rides for elder kids, small maze house for young kids to play for 30-45 mins along with arcade games on the top floor which will make your kids fall in love with the place & you might find it difficult to control the expense. They do offer value recharges but honestly the place is expensive for regular visits.
This place is packed on weekends & their charges vary depending on regular working days to weekends / public holidays.
You get their card & if your kid or kids would play regularly at infiniti anderi or malad recharge once with a good value offer as they are valid for a year.
Some Games offer ticket rebates which you can put back in your card, collect few points and buy something from their store on the top floor.

A perfect mall to spend your weekend where you or your family can shop, kids can play a bit & all of you'll can get something to eat at the food court before leaving for home. Mall has ample space for parking, its clean & the crowd is good.

Overall a great place for kids to enjoy their weekend but it does burn a hole in your pocket.
